name: Shakti back-and-forth: amygdala signal right, then left
origin: Todd Murphy (Shakti software), after Persinger's vectorial hemisphericity theory
summary: Murphy's back-and-forth ('interhemispheric intrusion') session: 30 min of the amygdala signal over the right temporal lobe, its 'usually wrong' side, then 30 min over the left. Murphy says the first phase is expected to be unpleasant and that the switch can bring bliss or elation. His Bliss page calls the single-signal procedure 'Untested With Shakti, tested with Shakti Helmet'.
setting: Advanced users only, after a side test has shown the usual pattern for the signal (this file assumes the usual sides). The vendor says darkness and silence (sensory deprivation) help; eyes closed, relaxed. Run murphy-shakti-test-session-amygdala first.
schedule: Vendor rules: never on consecutive days, at most every 72 hours or weekly; 60-minute sessions at most once in 3 weeks.
notes: 'Alternative procedures' says to apply the signal 'over the (usually) WRONG side of your head for 30 minutes, and then immediately apply the same wave form to the (usually) CORRECT side'. 'Bliss' gives 20 to 30 min on a two-coil 'mono headset' and says 'Untested With Shakti, tested with Shakti Helmet'. Neither gives a length for phase 2: its 30 min is the project's choice. Played here: four coils over one temporal lobe per phase (FT8, C6, TP8, T10, then FT7, C5, TP7, T9), two pairs of one (+) and one (-) coil as the vendor wires its 8-coil unit. The amygdala burst is the project's rising sweep, 6 to 30 Hz, at the lab's burst length of 230 points (Ryczko 2002 p.1 [592], p.2 [593]) of 3 ms, 0.69 s. No point values were published; 4 s of silence follows each burst. Field strength: the vendor's 10 to 50 mG are gaussmeter readings at a coil (FAQ). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT that is about 56 uT at the coil face, 11 to 56 times the vendor's level. The sides rest on user reports. Richards, Koren & Persinger 1992 found 'no main hemispheric effects for any of the items', only more fear on one item in women on the right side (n = 24, p.2 [668], p.3 [669]). Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Phase 1 is 'EXPECTED to be unpleasant'; if it feels good, the vendor suspects a 'reversed' structure. If it gets too uncomfortable, press Skip to start phase 2. Never stop after phase 1: the vendor says the wrong side must always be followed by the correct side. For lingering effects the vendor names the ERP signal over the cerebellum (murphy-shakti-cerebellum-erp). Not for people with epilepsy, seizure history or a psychiatric condition; stop if distress continues in phase 2.

phases.name: Phase 1: amygdala signal, RIGHT side ('usually wrong')
Phase 2: amygdala signal, LEFT side ('usually correct')
